behaviors.find-numeronym-tool: The Numeronym generator appears in the Text tools and opens its own page.
behaviors.preserve-short-word: Entering a word of three letters or fewer shows the word unchanged.
behaviors.copy-numeronym: The generated numeronym can be copied to the clipboard.
behaviors.clear-input: Clearing the word removes the result and restores the empty result placeholder.

history.notes: The inputs use data-test-id because c-input-text renders that attribute rather than Playwright’s default data-testid. The copy and clear buttons are scoped to their respective input components.
